messages:
maya: Heads-up — a customer hit a weird onboarding failure in json-mode when using the samplekit + auth retry. Output from the function call got double-encoded after a 401->refresh loop and our schema validator kept rejecting it.
kevin: ugh. do you have logs / repro steps?
maya: repro steps: 1) run samplekit with SDK v0.8.2 2) simulate token expiry on first toolcall 3) SDK retries auth & replays the call 4) tool output ends up like ""{\"id\": "123", \"items\": [1,2]}"" (stringified JSON inside a JSON string) so json-mode parsing fails.
igor: that sounds like the retry wrapper is doing a stringify before re-injecting the tool output into the request body. We saw something similar in an old helper patch.
kevin: hmm our node/python parity tests didn't catch this because the fixture mocked a successful auth. failing on 401 path.
maya: minimal log snippet: ```
[SDK] -> POST /v1/funcs/foo {input: {...}}
[API] 401 Unauthorized
[SDK] auth.refreshToken() -> success
[SDK] -> POST /v1/funcs/foo {input: {..., tool_response: "{"id":"123","items":[1,2]}"}}
[Server] receives tool_response as string and json-mode tries to parse => throws SchemaError
```
kevin: ok repro is clear. two followups: a) we need a unit test that simulates auth retry and ensures tool outputs remain raw objects, not stringified b) propose a small SDK helper: `normalizeToolOutput` that runs before replay and does `try { if (typeof x === 'string') x = safeParse(x) } catch { /* leave as-is */ }` and also ensures the `content-type: application/json` flag is preserved.
igor: +1 but be careful: sometimes tools legitimately return strings (e.g., HTML snippets). our helper needs to only parse when json-mode/schema is active or when content-type indicates json.
maya: agreed. suggestion: default behavior in json-mode should be to prefer objects, but only if schema is present or content-type is json. add an env flag `REDWOOD_SDK_JSONMODE_TOLERANT=true` for customers who want auto-coerce.
kevin: I'll whip up a draft PR. Plan: add integration test in samplekit that toggles simulated 401 and asserts final parsed type is object for JSON-mode toolcall. also add parity test in python.
maya: can you include a note in the samplekit README about the auth-retry edge? New users hit this and it's painful during onboarding.
kevin: will do. assigning to me. tagging build-bot to run CI on the branch. @build-bot please run `ci/integration --pattern samplekit-auth-retry` once PR is up. :robot_face: 
build-bot: CI queued for pattern samplekit-auth-retry. link: https://ci.redwood.example/queue/12345
igor: after PR we should also add a small fuzz test that randomizes tool outputs and ensures the replay is idempotent. catches any stringify/regression.
maya: thanks both. this will unblock a customer P0 onboarding issue.
kevin: ETA: PR + tests by EOD tomorrow.
maya: awesome, appreciate it :thumbsup:
